messages:
Nia (CS): Heads-up — AtlasGrid hit a renewal watch after a steady 17% token cost increase and a few slow report generations. AE asked for rapid, low-risk mitigations to present before their exec sync. Proposing compact-int8 pilot + length-aware routing + prefix caching. Can we scope impact & risks?
Cal (SE): Do we have per-endpoint seq_len distribution? that will influence cutoff and batching gains.
Rohan (RE): Pulled a 5d sample: median seq ~580, ~11% >1800 (these are the costly reports). int8 looks safe for <=1200 for ~87% traffic but need fidelity on labeled set.
Maya (AE): Customer will accept a 72h pilot if we provide a 1-pager + clear rollback triggers. Also they want an ops toggle to pause pilot instantly.
Nia (CS): Quick plan: 1) Canary compact-int8 for seq_len<=1200 with prefix_kv on. 2) Route >1200 to redwood-standard-1-fp16 on dedicated. 3) Reserve small dedicated burst pool during US business hours. 4) Deliver customer one-pager + request 3 failure examples.
Cal (SE): I'll deploy a staging split route and collect p50/p95/p99 + token_cpm. Snippet I'll use (staging):
```
route {
  match: path: "/v1/report"
  condition: "seq_len <= 1200"
  split: "80/15"
  models: ["redwood-compact-1-int8","redwood-standard-1-fp16"]
  fallback: "dedicated-burst"
}
route {
  match: path: "/v1/report"
  condition: "seq_len > 1200"
  models: ["redwood-standard-1-fp16"]
}
cache: { prefix_kv: true }
batching: { max_batch_ms: 50 }
```
Rohan (RE): I'll run fidelity A/B on their 6k labeled prompts (BLEU + embedding drift + hallucination heuristics) and include per-length buckets. Will flag any critical-case regressions.
OpsBot: [monitor] atlasgrid-prod token_cost_change=+17% window=2026-02-12T11:00Z->2026-02-12T17:00Z p95=1.05s p99=2.5s
Nia (CS): Timeline: Cal staging perf & dashboard (ETA 3h), Rohan evals + flagged cases (ETA 5h), Maya to schedule pilot opt-in call & request 3 customer examples (ETA EOD), Nia one-pager draft (ETA EOD).
Cal (SE): Deploying staging route now. Will post dashboard link and a short CSV of latency & cost deltas.
Rohan (RE): Early eval preview: int8 cohort est cost -21% for <=1200 bucket; median latency -11%; p99 -14%. Quality: 90% of samples negligible drift; 4 flagged prompts where citation phrasing differed. Investigating patterns.
Maya (AE): Good start. Nia, include rollback criteria: any customer-provided critical-case failing OR >1.5% drop on core metric. Also include a simple ops toggle in the one-pager.
Nia (CS): Agreed. Action items recap: Cal	staging deploy & perf (3h), Rohan	final fidelity report + examples (5h), Maya	stakeholder sync + examples (EOD), Nia	one-pager + pilot template (EOD). Keep updates here; put artifacts in /shared/atlasgrid-pilot. :thumbsup:
